original_prompt:
Title: The Brave Little Rabbit

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Ruby who lived in a beautiful forest.

One day, Ruby heard a tiny bird crying near a river. The bird had fallen from its nest and couldn't fly.

Ruby wanted to help, but the river was deep and dangerous.

She quickly called her forest friends. A clever monkey brought a long branch, and a strong elephant carefully lifted the bird.

Together, they saved the little bird!

The bird happily flew back to its mother.

All the animals praised Ruby for her kindness.

Ruby smiled and said, "Even the smallest animal can make a big difference!"

Moral: Kindness and teamwork can make the impossible possible.
